data.narrative:
Reverion is a Series B climate and energy technology company that has raised $79M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of nine private companies and one public company (Lilium Aviation, LNZA) operating in the same sector, with particular focus on three same-stage peers: KoBold Metals ($3.0B Series C), Electric Hydrogen ($1.0B Series C), and Amogy ($700M Series C).

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression methodology, using $79M in total raised as a valuation proxy and applying a typical 1.9x step-up multiplier for Series B progression, implies a valuation of $150M. Peer-median analysis across the three identified climate and energy comparables yields a $1.0B implied valuation, with a range spanning $700M to $3.0B. The divergence between methods reflects both the early-stage nature of Reverion relative to Series C peers and the inherent width of the climate-tech sector.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $128M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median estimate of $575M. This wide range reflects material uncertainty around capital efficiency relative to peer cohorts, technology-to-market timelines, and the sector's dependence on policy and commodity price dynamics. Near-term clarification on unit economics and customer pipeline would narrow the range materially.
